newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Death toll in Mozambique bus crash rises to 51.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Mozambique bus crash rises to 51.

text.p: The death toll in a collision between two packed buses in southern Mozambique earlier this week has risen to 51, police said on Thursday.
A spokesman said 32 people were injured when the vehicles, one a minibus, collided on Tuesday on the country's main north-south highway, about 80 km (50 miles) north of Maputo.
